metadata.description: hairline (free status line) and statusline-forge (status line designer skill) for Claude Code

plugins.name: hairline
plugins.description: A minimal, muted one-line status line: model, path, git, context and session usage bars, cost and reset countdown. No dependencies, no Nerd Font needed.

plugins.name: statusline-forge
plugins.description: Design, preview, install and debug a custom Claude Code status line in plain language. 25 segments, 7 themes, 5 presets, zero dependencies.
